sim.title: Simulation bench
sim.subtitle: Pick an algorithm, feed it input, and watch every step from the inside
sim.attack_hint: Enter Caesar ciphertext (English) and the attack will try all 25 keys
sim.breaker_hint: Enter Vigenère ciphertext (long English, 40+ letters) to recover length and key
sim.mitm_hint: Enter Alice's message — Eve intercepts with her secrets and reads it while Bob fails
sim.collision_hint: Enter a base text and the attack finds a real truncated SHA-256 collision
sim.dict_hint: Enter an MD5 digest (or any text) and the 30-word list will be tried against it
sim.rsa_decrypt_hint: To decrypt, paste the space-separated values produced by encryption
sim.rsa_hint: Arabic, English and symbols work with default keys — emoji needs larger p and q
sim.need_run: Run the simulation to inspect steps here
sim.elgamal_note: Randomized encryption — same text gives a different pair each time; output is c1,c2 pairs
sim.playfair_note: Latin letters only — J merges into I, X splits and pads
sim.dh_note: Key exchange — no ciphertext here, output is the shared secret
sim.tests_hint: Computed live on your current input — not fixed text
